svg.aria-label: NCP local simulation v1 candidate Engram coordinates one local experiment and privately owns neural state. CREBAIN owns body and fusion state. Prisoma captures exact step pairs. Galadriel records actual detector output with explicit abstention. Each owner exchanges bounded NCP requests and exact retained results through its own private process pipes. NCP is the shared contract, not another simulation engine. This candidate targets local Darwin simulation. Haldir gating, remote endpoints, physical actuation, and real-time guarantees are excluded. Gated requests must be rejected before endpoint preparation. Capture and monitor results grant no command authority. One Visual modality remains insufficient for Galadriel's unchanged two-modality minimum. An unavailable observation never becomes a zero residual or a nominal report. The tested Engram implementation is private Paper2Brain source. The public Engram repository is a placeholder, not an executable release. NCP sits at the center as a shared interface. Solid connections identify local v1 adapters; the dash-dot connection identifies Haldir's pinned v0.8 adapter. Short dashed arrows show library dependencies. A long dashed open arrow connects CREBAIN to Prisoma for environment and sensor data; that integration remains under qualification. Dotted lines show assets or exports. Moving dashes on a continuous line identify perception tools. Motion is decorative; each connection retains its meaning when still. These connections do not require every project to run together or depict a runtime broker. Installed-artifact qualification and final release gates remain open.

svg.text: THE SYSTEM // HOW THE WORK CONNECTS
Connections show interfaces, not a required all-project deployment.
Haldir stays on v0.8. Local v1 gated requests are rejected before preparation.
Local v1 candidate: installed qualification and final release gates remain open.

g.title: ncp to haldir: Pinned Haldir interface. dash-dot line, square end.
galadriel to pidrs: PID library dependency. dashed arrow.
prisoma to pidrs: PID and runlog dependency. dashed arrow.
crebain to prisoma: Environment + sensors. under qualification. long dashed line, open arrow.
crebain to cobotatlas: Simulation assets. dotted line, no arrow.
crebain to melkor: Simulation scenarios. dotted line, no arrow.
crebain to reliefatlas: Simulation assets. dotted line, no arrow.
cortexel to engram: Figure export. dotted line, no arrow.
manwe to crebain: Perception tools. moving dashes on a continuous line.
ncp to engram: Neural. solid paired arrows.
ncp to galadriel: Monitor. solid paired arrows.
ncp to prisoma: Capture. solid paired arrows.
ncp to crebain: Body. solid paired arrows.
NCP paired contract rails
g.desc: Opposed contract rails carry an amber request and a distinct blue outcome. Two separated metal rim halves represent independent peers. The open center is an interface, not a central runtime. The exchange repeats slowly; reduced motion keeps the full mark still.

g.title: CREBAIN raven and scope
g.desc: A graphite raven with field-green highlights faces left against a blue-black disc and a brushed gunmetal rim. Its red optical eye brightens and dims slowly. An occasional soft glint crosses the crown. Reduced motion keeps the mark still.

g.title: Galadriel sensor monitor
g.desc: A scanning red eye watches three incoming sensor channels inside an angular shield. A brushed gunmetal rim and restrained red inset frame the advisory monitor. The eye and feed pulses repeat; reduced motion keeps the full mark still.

g.title: Haldir command gate
g.desc: Two teal pylons and a chamfered frame surround a command threshold. The repeating sequence consumes an intent, checks separate authority, and constructs a different command. The gate rests closed. Reduced motion keeps the closed mark still. This is experimental authorization policy, not certification.
